about.intro.body: OmaXCtl finds the accounts you follow on X that have gone quiet and unfollows them in small, paced, backed-up batches, so you get under X's follow limit without losing the people who matter. This window is only the controls. The work is done by the x_tool engine in the DIL toolbox (x_tool following …), which this window runs and reads. OmaXCtl never clicks X itself.
about.audit.title: 1. Audit: build the list of who you follow
about.audit.body: Start audit opens a background tab in a "for agents" browser that is already signed in to your X account, without taking your focus. It launches one only if none is running. From that tab it reads your whole following list, 200 accounts at a time, using the tab's own signed-in session. About 7,500 follows take a few minutes. For each account it records whether they follow you, whether the account is protected, its follower count, and the date of its newest post, reply or repost. Rows appear here as they arrive, so you can work while the audit runs.
about.filters.title: 2. Filters: choose who to unfollow
about.filters.body: Set how long an account must have been inactive (days, weeks or months) and a minimum follower count. Verified inactive means the account's newest post, reply and repost are all older than your window. Likely inactive also includes accounts whose posts and replies are old but whose repost dates are unknown. Accounts that follow you, accounts on your keep list, and protected accounts are never selected. The count above the list is exactly what Unfollow will act on.
about.unfollow.title: 3. Unfollow: a paced, cancelable batch
about.unfollow.body: Unfollow asks once for confirmation, then backs up your whole follows list and starts a batch on its own background tab. It unfollows one account at a time, about 20 seconds apart, and the button counts down what's left. Before each unfollow it reloads the profile, skips the account if it now follows you or is protected, clicks Unfollow, checks that the confirmation dialog names that exact account, then reloads the profile to confirm the change. Cancel stops after the account in progress. Any X warning, or an unfollow that can't be confirmed, stops the batch with nothing retried.
about.now.title: Right-click: Unfollow now, Keep, Open profile
about.now.body: Right-click any account. Unfollow now unfollows just that account, whatever the filters say, with the same backup and checks. It's unavailable for accounts that follow you, are protected, or are on your keep list. Keep adds the account to your keep list so it is never unfollowed. Click a row to see its last activity and why it was or wasn't selected.
about.safety.title: Protections
about.safety.body: Mutuals, your keep list and protected accounts are always skipped, and each one is checked again on X just before an unfollow. Only one batch runs per account at a time, and the audit and a batch never share a browser tab. The list is read through X's web list endpoint. Unfollows go through the normal profile button and are confirmed by reading the profile again, so nothing is changed through a hidden write call.
about.history.title: History
about.history.body: Every batch starts with a read-only, hash-checked backup of your entire follows list, your keep list, the filters used and the accounts chosen. The History tab lists those backups. Open one to see each chosen account and what happened to it: unfollowed, skipped (and why), or stopped. x_tool can use this record to review refollows.
about.keys.title: Window and keys
about.keys.body: Drag the title bar to move the window. Ctrl+= and Ctrl+- zoom from 50% to 150%, and Ctrl+0 resets to 70%. In the list, Home and End jump to the top and bottom, Page Up and Page Down scroll a screenful, and you can drag the wide scroll handle to scrub through. Escape closes a menu, then the window. Your filters, zoom and window size are remembered.
about.data.title: Where things live
about.data.body: Plugin: ~/dil/plugins/omaxctl, linked as ~/.config/omarchy/plugins/moo.omaxctl. Engine: ~/dil/toolbox/x_tool (prune.py and relationships.py). Data, scans, backups and the audit log: the DIL state folder under x_tool/relationships. Task: DIL-3473.
about.risk.title: Be aware
about.risk.body: X's rules restrict automated activity. OmaXCtl keeps the pace slow and stops at the first sign of trouble, but any automation carries some risk to your account. Start with a small batch and check History before running large ones.
